SPECIFIC NOTES This is a Standing Order for SELECTION OF IPR FIRM as specified in this order, as follows a) Basic Estimated Financial Limit of this contract is INR 5,00,00,000/- (Rupees Five Crore only) for Two Years and Agency should ensure that the Cumulative Value of items supplied or services / work done aga inst this order shall not exceed the Financial Limit given above. b) The Financial Limit of Rs. 5,00,00,000 is indicative only. The actual financial limit in the SAP PO shall be a s per approved GeM contract value. 70:30 Split Clause: · The Total Estimated Financial Limit of this Rate Contract is proposed to be distributed between 2 Vendors in the ratio of 70:30. · L1 bidder shall be assigned 70% & L2 bidder shall be assigned 30% of the GEM PO Value and This shall be subject to L2 Bidder matching L1 rates in the event L2 bidder doesn’t accept L 1 rates & 1 00% PO value shall be placed on L1 Bidder. c) During the Validity of this contract, depending on its requirements from time to time, HPCL shall issue I ndents, specifying the Quantities required to be supplied. That is, NO Material should be supplied or servi ces/works to be done against this Rate Contract PO; the Material should be supplied or services/works to be done ONLY against the Indents issued subsequently d) HPCL shall NOT be bound/ obligated to procure any minimum quantity of any Item nor any minimum val ue of material/ services/works and HPCL does not assure nor guarantee availing / consumption of any mi nimum Financial Limit, from the Vendor e) Do not upload the Price details in the technical bid. Offers from vendors uploading the Price details or an y other document indicating prices along with technical bid shall be rejected without any further correspo ndence. SCOPE OF JOB The scope of job shall include providing end-to-end Intellectual Property (IP) services for technologies deve loped by HPCL, including patentability and prior-art searches, patent drafting, filing, prosecution, maintena nce and management of patent applications in India and abroad, PCT and foreign filings, patent landscape studies, freedom-to-operate (FTO) analyses, technology intelligence, assistance in compliance with Nation al Biodiversity Authority (NBA) requirements, trademark, copyright and industrial design-related services, I P advisory, licensing and commercialization support, and such other IP-related activities as may be assign ed by HPCL during the contract period. Regular Vehicles HPCL’s SCOPE OF SUPPLY: HPCL shall provide, on a need basis, the technical disclosures, invention details, research data, inventor in puts, relevant supporting documents, authorization letters, executed forms, and such other information as may be reasonably required by the selected Intellectual Property (IP) Firm for carrying out the assigned ser vices. HPCL shall facilitate interactions with inventors and concerned officials for clarification of technical a spects of inventions and shall review and provide comments/approvals on drafts, reports, and other delive

rables within reasonable timelines. Any additional information required for execution of the assignment sh all be provided by HPCL subject to availability and applicable confidentiality requirements AGENCY’S SCOPE OF SUPPLY: The Vendor shall take care of the resources and requirements necessary for the satisfactory execution of t he services under the contract. The Vendor shall be responsible for preparation and submission of all repor ts, patent specifications, applications, responses, opinions, analyses, presentations, statutory forms, and o ther deliverables required under the scope of work. The Vendor shall also arrange coordination with foreig n associates, wherever required, and ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and profe ssional requirements for execution of the assigned services. The vendor shall be capable of providing full s ervices relating to IP and shall be capable of handling such volumes of work. The bidder must submit their professional charges along with the corresponding official (govt.) fees, where ver applicable, for the below mentioned activities in INR only. The bidder must exclude professional charge s of foreign agents/attorneys, official fee of foreign patent offices, taxes and so forth. Official fees of foreig n patent offices and foreign agent/attorney fees would be paid as per original bill/invoices as spent on actu al basis only. Any charges associated with PCT related fees in foreign currency, Foreign Patent offices, fore ign associate charges, translation charges, etc., would be reimbursed separately as per original bill/invoice s as spent on actual basis only. Any late fees associated with the delay due to the attorney or their associa tes would not be borne by HPCL. CONTRACT PERIOD The contract shall be valid for a period of two years from the date of release of GEM PO, The rates shall be firm until completion of the order.
